killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) gives each typeface the package and version src/game/fonts/README.md records for its files
why: The package version is written twice, in src/game/fonts/README.md's table and in the declaration the notices render from, and the README's update steps are the only thing that keeps them together. A bump that refreshes one leaves the notices citing a package the files did not come from. Scoped to vendored.test.ts alone: generate.test.ts's regenerate-and-diff would also fail, but only until `npm run notices` is run, after which the declaration and the committed notices agree on the mistake.
